# AK Render

> Declarative page compiler for coding agents: a short YAML or JSON Page Spec in, one deterministic, offline, self-contained HTML file out. The agent describes meaning; the compiler owns layout, colour, typography, motion, accessibility and security. npm package: `@bestagentkits/render`, CLI: `ak-render`.

Agent loop: `ak-render catalog` once, `ak-render describe <type> --json` for each block you use, `ak-render validate <spec|-> --json` and fix every diagnostic by its JSON path, then `ak-render <spec|-> --out page.html`. Pass `-` to read the spec from stdin. `ak-render mcp` exposes the same loop as MCP tools over stdio (`catalog`, `describe`, `validate`, `render`, `themes`); `render` writes the file and returns only a summary.

Do not write HTML, CSS or inline scripts: the spec has no field for them. Output makes no network request unless the spec opts in under `policy.network`.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): the loop, a minimal spec, MCP setup, and rules that save retries
- [README](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/README.md): install, library API and CLI
- [Themes](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/themes.md): built-in presets, custom presets and embedded fonts
- [Media and network policy](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/media-policy.md): what loads offline and how to opt in

## Reference

- [Page Spec JSON Schema](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/schema/page-spec.v1.json): machine-readable schema for editors and validators
- [Example specs](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/tree/main/fixtures/pages): plan, explain, recap, diff, dashboard, media, interactive and showcase pages
